items.summary: Independent review rejects all new implementation queue work this cycle. No candidate is safely queueable: existing high-priority work, 52 failed-request follow-ups, 33 improvements awaiting measurement, unavailable operations/security sweeps, incomplete attribution, and only two proven outcomes leave release and measurement gates uncleared. Revenue, ROI, margin, payback, and causal lift remain unknown; aggregate commission stays unattributed. Continue only existing repair-or-close, period-aligned reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Retain SEO, affiliate, UX, and site-factory candidates as deferred backlog until ownership, validation, rollback, compliance, security, attribution, and measurement gates clear. No new telemetry, spend, credentials, configuration, deployment, requeue, or monetization change is authorized.
